newsitem.title: UK: Britain's Tomkins to buy Stant for $605 million.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Tomkins to buy Stant for $605 million.

text.p: Tomkins PLC, a British company with operations ranging from baking to engineering, said Wednesday it will buy auto parts maker Stant Corp. for $406 million.

Tomkins said it will pay $21.50 a share for all of Stant's outstanding shares and assume Stant's estimated $200 million in debt. News of the deal sent Stant's stock soaring $4.625 to $21.25 on Nasdaq.
The company said Bessemer Capital Partners LP of New York, which owns 56.9 percent of Stant, agreed to tender its shares to Tomkins, which also owns auto parts supplier Gates Rubber Company.

Stant, which employs more than 7,000 people in the United States, Mexico, the United Kingdom and Australia, manufactures automotive parts and supplies, including windscreen wiper blades, engine thermostats, hose clamps and tools.
Stant is based in Richmond, Ind.

"Stant expands our product offering to the automotive original equipment market and increases the range and volume of products we can distribute through Gates Rubber Company," said Tomkins' chairman Greg Hutchings.
Tomkins said it was confident that the purchase would enhance earnings.
